row:
Dallas Animal Chiropractic provides gentle, individualized chiropractic care for dogs and cats in Carrollton and throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth area.

Dr. Andie Ibarra, D.C., is a certified animal chiropractor focused on supporting mobility, comfort, movement, and overall function through hands-on chiropractic care. Cold laser therapy may also be incorporated when appropriate.
New patients require a veterinarian-signed referral before scheduling.
